# Connector reference

Every connector the 19 plugins provide, from the front matter of each plugin's README (the one home of a connector: what it reads, every setting with its meaning, the data structure, examples and troubleshooting). A connector is switched on by a file in `config/connectors/`; what such a file holds and how packs suggest one is in the [Data guide](../guides/DATA_GUIDE.md).

| Connector | Plugin | What it does | Capabilities |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`activemq`](#the-activemq-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-activemq`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-activemq/README.md) | Live entities from ActiveMQ Classic queues and topics (OpenWire), the latest document per entity kept in a local RocksDB state store that survives restarts. | fetch, search, subscribe |
| [`aerospike`](#the-aerospike-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-aerospike`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-aerospike/README.md) | Reads dated kinds from Aerospike, one record per entity per business day with promoted fields as bins, an index record per entity and a dates record per kind. | fetch, search, history, reverse-lookup, bulk-scan |
| [`cassandra`](#the-cassandra-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-cassandra`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-cassandra/README.md) | Reads dated kinds from Apache Cassandra, ScyllaDB and DataStax Astra, one partition per business day per bucket, with promoted columns for searches. | fetch, search, history, reverse-lookup, bulk-scan |
| [`delta`](#the-delta-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-delta`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-delta/README.md) | Reads dated kinds from a Delta Lake on local disk or S3, one table per kind partitioned by business day, without ever loading a day whole. | fetch, search, history, reverse-lookup, bulk-scan |
| [`demo`](#the-demo-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-demo`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-demo/README.md) | Every enabled pack's sample documents, read into memory at start and served for every kind, with live samples ticking; the server's default route. Switch it off in production. | fetch, search, subscribe, reverse-lookup |
| [`duckdb`](#the-duckdb-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-duckdb`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-duckdb/README.md) | Reads dated kinds from one embedded DuckDB file, a schema per data domain, in-process with no database server; a load swaps the file under the running server. | fetch, search, history, reverse-lookup, bulk-scan |
| [`feed`](#the-feed-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-feeds`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-feeds/README.md) | Public market data held in memory and refreshed on a timer, one connector per feed - NY Fed SOFR, ECB €STR and FX reference rates, the US Treasury par curve, FRED series - dated by observation. | fetch, search, history |
| [`file`](#the-file-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-file`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-file/README.md) | Reads plain files in a folder, one JSON-lines file per kind per business day (or one file per entity), indexing a day on first use so a read never scans it. | fetch, search, history, reverse-lookup, bulk-scan |
| [`iceberg`](#the-iceberg-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-iceberg`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-iceberg/README.md) | Reads dated kinds from Apache Iceberg tables laid out for Drishti (one table per kind, partitioned by business day, sorted by id), path-based or through a REST catalog. | fetch, search, history, reverse-lookup, bulk-scan |
| [`iceberg-external`](#the-iceberg-external-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-iceberg-external`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-iceberg-external/README.md) | Serves Apache Iceberg tables that other engines write (Spark, Flink, Trino, Snowflake, Glue, dbt, pyiceberg), in their own layout, as Drishti kinds; a row is an entity's document. | fetch, search, history, reverse-lookup, bulk-scan |
| [`jdbc`](#the-jdbc-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-jdbc`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-jdbc/README.md) | Reads a relational database over JDBC, either Drishti's partitioned entities table (table mode, PostgreSQL) or your own tables through one SQL query per kind (query mode). | fetch, search, history, reverse-lookup, bulk-scan |
| [`kafka`](#the-kafka-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-kafka`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-kafka/README.md) | Live entities from Kafka topics, the latest message per key, read from the beginning of every partition with no consumer group; views tick on each message. | fetch, search, subscribe |
| [`mongodb`](#the-mongodb-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-mongodb`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-mongodb/README.md) | Reads dated kinds from MongoDB, a document per entity per business day keyed kind/id/yyyyMMdd, with a narrow columns collection for searches over a whole day. | fetch, search, history, reverse-lookup, bulk-scan |
| [`news`](#the-news-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-news`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-news/README.md) | Headlines about a named entity, computed on demand from Google News RSS (no key), filtered for relevance, de-duplicated, newest first and cached per name. Off as shipped. | fetch, search |
| [`rabbitmq`](#the-rabbitmq-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-rabbitmq`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-rabbitmq/README.md) | Live entities from RabbitMQ queues (AMQP 0-9-1), acknowledged only once kept in a local RocksDB state store that survives restarts. | fetch, search, subscribe |
| [`redis`](#the-redis-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-redis`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-redis/README.md) | Reads today and the last few days from Redis (single instance or Cluster), a compressed key per entity per day and a chunked column hash per day, and pushes live changes to open views. | fetch, search, subscribe, history, reverse-lookup, bulk-scan |
| [`rest`](#the-rest-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-rest`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-rest/README.md) | One HTTP GET per entity to an in-house JSON service; the answer is the document. Fetch only, undated. | fetch |
| [`s3`](#the-s3-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-s3`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-s3/README.md) | Reads one JSON object per entity from Amazon S3 or an S3-compatible store (MinIO, Ceph), optionally in a folder per business date; ids kept for type-ahead (the `index.*` settings), no table format, no loader. | fetch, search, history |
| [`yfinance`](#the-yfinance-connector) | [`drishti-plugin-yfinance`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-yfinance/README.md) | A quote and recent price history for a ticker, computed on demand from Yahoo Finance's unofficial public chart endpoint (no key). Off as shipped; samples and internal use only. | fetch, search |

## The activemq connector

Live entities from ActiveMQ Classic queues and topics (OpenWire), the latest document per entity kept in a local RocksDB state store that survives restarts.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plugin | [`plugins/drishti-plugin-activemq`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-activemq/README.md) (its README: settings explained, data structure, examples) |
| Capabilities | `fetch`, `search`, `subscribe` |
| Setting keys | `broker-url`, `destinations`, `user`, `password`, `client-id`, `kind`, `id-field`, `kind.*`, `id-field.*`, `cache-mb`, `state.dir`, `state.root`, `state.max-gb`, `state.reset-at`, `state.zone`, `state.durability`, `state.when-full`, `state.check-seconds`, `max-redeliveries`, `tls.*` |
| Authentication | Broker user and password (password as ${ENV} or file:), TLS and mutual TLS on ssl:// endpoints (tls.*). |
| Licence | Apache ActiveMQ client 6.3.2 (activemq-client, Apache-2.0) with the Jakarta Messaging API (jakarta.jms-api, EPL-2.0 / GPL-2.0 with Classpath Exception) and RocksDB (rocksdbjni, Apache-2.0/GPL-2.0) for the state store, bundled. |
| Windows | Works on Windows (pure Java client); the state store's RocksDB library is unpacked from its jar into the server's temp folder (no .exe). The broker runs elsewhere; the Docker tests skip where Docker is not reachable. |

## The aerospike connector

Reads dated kinds from Aerospike, one record per entity per business day with promoted fields as bins, an index record per entity and a dates record per kind.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plugin | [`plugins/drishti-plugin-aerospike`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-aerospike/README.md) (its README: settings explained, data structure, examples) |
| Capabilities | `fetch`, `search`, `history`, `reverse-lookup`, `bulk-scan` |
| Setting keys | `layout.*`, `hosts`, `namespace`, `set`, `domain`, `kinds`, `user`, `password`, `auth-mode`, `tls-name`, `connect-timeout-ms`, `pool-size`, `pool-min-idle`, `pool-idle-timeout`, `pool-max-lifetime`, `pool-connection-timeout`, `pool-leak-threshold`, `statement-timeout`, `refresh-seconds`, `lookback-days`, `max-load-rows`, `scan-threads`, `columns-cache-mb`, `columns-seconds`, `reverse-index`, `tls.*` |
| Authentication | Internal log-in (user + password as ${ENV} or file:), external (LDAP), or pki (the client certificate is the log-in); TLS through tls.* and tls-name (TLS needs Aerospike Enterprise Edition). |
| Licence | Aerospike Java client for JDK 21 (Apache-2.0), bundled; no native library. |
| Windows | Works the same on Windows (pure Java client); the server is yours to run, and tools/load-aerospike.sh needs bash. |

## The delta connector

Reads dated kinds from a Delta Lake on local disk or S3, one table per kind partitioned by business day, without ever loading a day whole.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plugin | [`plugins/drishti-plugin-delta`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-delta/README.md) (its README: settings explained, data structure, examples) |
| Capabilities | `fetch`, `search`, `history`, `reverse-lookup`, `bulk-scan` |
| Setting keys | `lake`, `lake-tables`, `root`, `domain`, `kinds`, `mode.*`, `layout.*`, `table.*`, `hadoop.*`, `engine`, `date-column`, `id-column`, `doc-column`, `warm-dates`, `refresh-seconds`, `lookback-days`, `max-load-rows`, `max-concurrent-reads`, `max-queued-reads`, `cache-mb`, `doc-cache-mb`, `doc-disk-cache.enabled`, `doc-disk-cache.dir`, `doc-disk-cache.max-gb`, `doc-disk-cache.ttl`, `doc-disk-cache.reset-at`, `doc-disk-cache.zone`, `id-map-disk.enabled`, `id-map-disk.dir`, `id-map-disk.max-gb`, `id-map-disk.ttl`, `id-map-disk.idle-release`, `columns-cache-mb`, `id-map-mb`, `lz4-via-native`, `lz4-decoder`, `s3.endpoint`, `s3.region`, `s3.path-style`, `s3.access-key`, `s3.secret-key`, `index.days`, `index.max-memory`, `index.warm`, `index.any-recent-day`, `index.storage`, `index.max-disk`, `index.reload-every`, `index.block-cache`, `index.kinds.*`, `tls.*`, `proxy.*` |
| Authentication | Local files need none; S3 takes s3.access-key and s3.secret-key (${ENV} or file:) or the AWS credential chain; a private CA or client certificate through tls.* (native engine only); an outbound proxy through proxy.*. |
| Licence | Drishti's own native Delta engine (drishti-deltalake) with Delta Kernel, Apache Hadoop client and AWS SDK for Java v2 (all Apache-2.0), bundled. |
| Windows | Works on Windows with engine native (the default), local folders and S3 alike; engine hadoop needs winutils.exe, so it is not for the Windows QA machine. Loader tools\windows\load-delta.ps1. |

## The demo connector

Every enabled pack's sample documents, read into memory at start and served for every kind, with live samples ticking; the server's default route. Switch it off in production.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plugin | [`plugins/drishti-plugin-demo`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-demo/README.md) (its README: settings explained, data structure, examples) |
| Capabilities | `fetch`, `search`, `subscribe`, `reverse-lookup` |
| Setting keys | `dirs`, `ticking`, `tick-ms` |
| Authentication | None (no network, no credentials); it reads only the samples folders its catalogues list. |
| Licence | No client library (drishti-api and drishti-common only). The samples are generated, made-up data. |
| Windows | Works the same on Windows (pure Java, files only). |

## The duckdb connector

Reads dated kinds from one embedded DuckDB file, a schema per data domain, in-process with no database server; a load swaps the file under the running server.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plugin | [`plugins/drishti-plugin-duckdb`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-duckdb/README.md) (its README: settings explained, data structure, examples) |
| Capabilities | `fetch`, `search`, `history`, `reverse-lookup`, `bulk-scan` |
| Setting keys | `layout.*`, `path`, `table`, `kinds`, `memory-limit`, `threads`, `pool-size`, `refresh-seconds`, `lookback-days`, `max-load-rows`, `scan-threads`, `columns-cache-mb`, `columns-seconds`, `reverse-index`, `index.days`, `index.max-memory`, `index.warm`, `index.any-recent-day`, `index.storage`, `index.max-disk`, `index.reload-every`, `index.block-cache`, `index.kinds.*` |
| Authentication | None; a local file read by the server process (file-system permissions only). |
| Licence | DuckDB JDBC driver 1.5.6 (MIT), bundled; it carries DuckDB's native library inside the jar, unpacked at start. |
| Windows | The connector reads on Windows (the native library is inside the jar, no .exe); a load cannot rename a file over one the server holds open, so load into a new path and switch path, or stop the server; tools/load-duckdb.sh needs bash. |

## The feed connector

Public market data held in memory and refreshed on a timer, one connector per feed - NY Fed SOFR, ECB €STR and FX reference rates, the US Treasury par curve, FRED series - dated by observation.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plugin | [`plugins/drishti-plugin-feeds`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-feeds/README.md) (its README: settings explained, data structure, examples) |
| Capabilities | `fetch`, `search`, `history` |
| Setting keys | `url`, `feed`, `series`, `api-key`, `user-agent`, `refresh-minutes`, `timeout-seconds`, `tls.*`, `proxy.*` |
| Authentication | None for four feeds; FRED needs a free API key (api-key as ${FRED_API_KEY}). tls.* for an https:// mirror on a private CA; proxy.* for an outbound proxy. |
| Licence | No client library (the JDK's HttpClient; Jackson for JSON). The data is the publishers' (NY Fed, ECB, US Treasury, St. Louis Fed); their terms apply. |
| Windows | Works the same on Windows (pure Java); a mirror can be a file:/// URL on a local disk. |

Reads a relational database over JDBC, either Drishti's partitioned entities table (table mode, PostgreSQL) or your own tables through one SQL query per kind (query mode).

|---|---|

| Authentication | None (no API key). tls.* for an https:// mirror or proxy on a private CA; proxy.* for an outbound proxy. |
| Licence | No client library (the JDK's HttpClient and XML parser, Jackson). Google's terms govern the feed; headlines and links belong to their publishers. |
| Windows | Works the same on Windows (pure Java). |

## The rabbitmq connector

Live entities from RabbitMQ queues (AMQP 0-9-1), acknowledged only once kept in a local RocksDB state store that survives restarts.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plugin | [`plugins/drishti-plugin-rabbitmq`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-rabbitmq/README.md) (its README: settings explained, data structure, examples) |
| Capabilities | `fetch`, `search`, `subscribe` |
| Setting keys | `uri`, `auth-mechanism`, `queues`, `bind.*`, `kind`, `id-field`, `kind.*`, `id-field.*`, `cache-mb`, `state.dir`, `state.root`, `state.max-gb`, `state.reset-at`, `state.zone`, `state.durability`, `state.when-full`, `state.check-seconds`, `declare`, `prefetch`, `heartbeat-seconds`, `recovery-interval-ms`, `tls.*` |
| Authentication | User and password in the amqp(s):// URI (as ${ENV} references), TLS and mutual TLS on amqps:// (tls.*), or the client certificate as the log-in (auth-mechanism external). |
| Licence | RabbitMQ Java client 5.36.0 (amqp-client, Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 / GPL-2.0) and RocksDB (rocksdbjni, Apache-2.0/GPL-2.0) for the state store, bundled. |
| Windows | Works on Windows (pure Java client); the state store's RocksDB library is unpacked from its jar into the server's temp folder (no .exe). The broker runs elsewhere; the Docker tests skip where Docker is not reachable. |

## The redis connector

Reads today and the last few days from Redis (single instance or Cluster), a compressed key per entity per day and a chunked column hash per day, and pushes live changes to open views.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plugin | [`plugins/drishti-plugin-redis`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-redis/README.md) (its README: settings explained, data structure, examples) |
| Capabilities | `fetch`, `search`, `subscribe`, `history`, `reverse-lookup`, `bulk-scan` |
| Setting keys | `layout.*`, `uri`, `user`, `password`, `cluster`, `domain`, `kinds`, `codec`, `live`, `fail-fast`, `timeout-ms`, `pool-size`, `pool-min-idle`, `pool-idle-timeout`, `pool-leak-threshold`, `pool-pipeline-depth`, `refresh-seconds`, `lookback-days`, `max-load-rows`, `threads`, `in-flight`, `heavy-reads`, `ttl-days`, `level`, `chunk-rows`, `dict-kb`, `dict-samples`, `recheck-ms`, `keep-replaced-seconds`, `columns-cache-mb`, `reverse-index`, `tls.*` |
| Authentication | Redis ACL user and password (${ENV} or file:, overriding the uri's); TLS with a rediss:// uri and the shared tls.* settings, including a client certificate. |
| Licence | Lettuce (MIT) and zstd-jni (BSD-2-Clause), bundled; zstd-jni carries its native library inside the jar. |
| Windows | Works on Windows as a plain network client (the native zstd library is inside the jar, no .exe); the server is yours to run, and tools/load-redis.sh needs bash. |

## The rest connector

One HTTP GET per entity to an in-house JSON service; the answer is the document. Fetch only, undated.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plugin | [`plugins/drishti-plugin-rest`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-rest/README.md) (its README: settings explained, data structure, examples) |
| Capabilities | `fetch` |
| Setting keys | `base-url`, `path`, `kinds`, `generation-header`, `timeout-ms`, `header.*`, `tls.*`, `proxy.*` |
| Authentication | Any request header (header.Authorization Bearer ${TOKEN}, an API key header), TLS and mutual TLS (tls.*), an outbound proxy with a login (proxy.*). |
| Licence | No client library (the JDK's java.net.http.HttpClient). |
| Windows | Works the same on Windows (pure Java). |

## The s3 connector

Reads one JSON object per entity from Amazon S3 or an S3-compatible store (MinIO, Ceph), optionally in a folder per business date; ids kept for type-ahead (the `index.*` settings), no table format, no loader.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plugin | [`plugins/drishti-plugin-s3`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-s3/README.md) (its README: settings explained, data structure, examples) |
| Capabilities | `fetch`, `search`, `history` |
| Setting keys | `bucket`, `prefix`, `endpoint`, `region`, `path-style`, `access-key`, `secret-key`, `rescan-seconds`, `lookback-days`, `cache-entries`, `cache-seconds`, `index.days`, `index.max-memory`, `index.warm`, `index.any-recent-day`, `index.storage`, `index.max-disk`, `index.reload-every`, `index.block-cache`, `index.kinds.*`, `tls.*`, `proxy.*` |
| Authentication | The AWS default credential chain (instance role, web identity, profile, environment), or static access-key and secret-key as ${ENV} or file:; a private CA through tls.*; an outbound proxy through proxy.*. Needs s3:ListBucket and s3:GetObject only. |
| Licence | AWS SDK for Java v2, S3 with the URL-connection and Apache 5 HTTP clients (Apache-2.0), bundled; no native library. |
| Windows | Works the same on Windows (pure Java SDK); no loader is needed, anything that can PUT an object feeds it. |

## The yfinance connector

A quote and recent price history for a ticker, computed on demand from Yahoo Finance's unofficial public chart endpoint (no key). Off as shipped; samples and internal use only.

|---|---|
| Plugin | [`plugins/drishti-plugin-yfinance`](../../plugins/drishti-plugin-yfinance/README.md) (its README: settings explained, data structure, examples) |

| Setting keys | `base-url`, `user-agent`, `range`, `interval`, `id-prefix`, `benchmark`, `kind`, `timeout-seconds`, `cache-ttl-seconds`, `cache-max-symbols`, `max-bytes`, `retries`, `retry-initial`, `retry-max`, `retry-factor`, `retry-jitter`, `tls.*`, `proxy.*` |
| Authentication | None (no API key). tls.* for an https:// mirror or proxy on a private CA; proxy.* for an outbound proxy. |
| Licence | No client library (the JDK's HttpClient, Jackson). The endpoint is unofficial and Yahoo's terms restrict its use; free price feeds forbid redistribution, so what it returns is for internal use only and is never committed or redistributed. |
| Windows | Works the same on Windows (pure Java). |
